title: Shopify: importing products
finding: Documents blank-versus-omitted overwrite behavior, variant-ID hazards, backups and development-store subset testing.
limits: Technical consequences, not incidence, buyer willingness or profit evidence.

title: Shopify: product CSV specification
finding: Documents fields, dependencies, image grouping and product versus variant metafield boundaries.
limits: A supported format is not an unmet market.

title: Shopify: common CSV import issues
finding: Lists import errors and explicitly points merchants to hiring a Shopify Partner.
limits: Does not establish how often errors occur or the earnings of specialists.

title: Matrixify pricing
finding: Advertises paid plans and existing per-job import/export capabilities.
limits: Prices are asking prices for software, not a comparable managed-service quote.

title: Matrixify job options
finding: Scheduling, recurring runs, result files and dry runs already exist; the vendor explains dry-run limitations.
limits: Documented functionality was not independently benchmarked in this audit.

title: Matrixify MCP
finding: Describes AI-agent supplier-file conversion, import/export execution and job monitoring.
limits: Advertised integration, not independent proof of accuracy on a customer's files.

title: Trusted Matrixify experts
finding: Names specialists in migrations, custom conversion templates and recurring imports.
limits: Supplier/referral evidence; no transaction amounts, margins or win rates.

title: Stock Sync app listing
finding: Offers scheduled supplier feeds, mapping, pricing and other catalog operations; established review base.
limits: Reviews do not prove every user is paying. Do not use the inconsistent Scale monthly/annual display as a reliable quotation.

title: Ablestar Bulk Product Edit
finding: Advertises bulk edits, change preview, undo, scheduled sales, supplier feeds and Sidekick integration.
limits: Existing feature coverage; not an independently measured product comparison.

title: Shelvio CSV and Excel importer
finding: Advertises AI mapping, saved supplier mappings and cleaning at US$9.99 and US$19.99 monthly; zero reviews shown.
limits: Competition/supply evidence only. Zero reviews does not prove zero users; performance was not tested.

title: ShopSheets free tools
finding: Offers free validators, converters, diff, encoding, image, barcode and inventory utilities.
limits: Advertised free coverage, not benchmarked equivalence to complex customer requirements.

title: CatalogWash
finding: Advertises a free report/preview and $9 cleanup sessions; public beta.
limits: Currency is not explicit in the observed page; paid adoption and results unverified.

title: Microsoft: Power Query combine files
finding: Explains combining same-schema files and refreshing reusable transformations.
limits: Existing Excel users may already have a solution; not free for everyone and not universal cleanup.

title: Akeneo Supplier Data Manager
finding: Describes supplier portals, normalization, matching, classification and AI mapping.
limits: Confirms mature competition, not suitability or affordability for every small agency.

title: Plytix product modules
finding: Shows PIM, digital assets, portals, feeds, data sheets and Shopify modules.
limits: Dynamic price fields were incomplete; no base-plan price is relied on. Some features are marked coming soon.

title: Channable feed management
finding: Advertises multi-channel feeds, rules and AI-assisted product-data processing.
limits: Vendor capability claims, not independent earnings evidence.

title: DataFeedWatch app
finding: Advertises channel feeds, AI enrichment, mapping, rules and agency support.
limits: Paid category/use signal; not proof a new competitor or separate quality checker will sell.

title: Shopify inventory states
finding: Distinguishes available, on-hand, committed, unavailable and incoming quantities.
limits: Business semantics require correct customer interpretation; no revenue evidence.

title: Shopify B2B quantities and pricing
finding: Quantity breaks and volume-pricing rules can be managed natively or via CSV.
limits: Availability and correctness do not establish demand for a standalone formatting service.

title: Shopify Markets catalogs
finding: Explains native catalog, currency, pricing and availability management.
limits: Do not turn a documented platform feature into an unsupported separate market claim.

title: Google GTIN requirements
finding: Requires accurate applicable identifiers and explicitly warns against guessing GTINs.
limits: A checksum cannot establish genuine product identity or sourcing rights.

title: Google product-data specification
finding: Specifies channel attributes, product data and image requirements; includes native issue diagnostics.
limits: Compliance checks do not guarantee approval, reinstatement or sales uplift.

title: WooCommerce CSV importer
finding: Built-in importer/exporter supports bulk products and column mapping.
limits: Shows a native alternative, not that every difficult migration is solved.

title: Shopify standard taxonomy
finding: Native categories, attribute links and automatic category suggestions exist.
limits: Customer context still matters; no standalone paid-demand proof.

title: Shopify redirects
finding: Native redirect handling and limitations are documented.
limits: Migration correctness is not an SEO performance guarantee.

title: Agency request: 3,000 products / eight catalogs
finding: Agency requests preparation/import and a paid small sample; 20–50 proposals shown.
limits: Direct page returned 403. Index only; no completed payment proof. Body says fixed price while metadata says hourly; not a reliable price benchmark.

title: Completed bulk-import work-history signal
finding: An indexed completed bulk-product-import entry spans Aug 6–Oct 17, 2026 with a rating.
limits: Direct page returned 403. Earnings private; no receipt, profitability, scope equivalence or recurring-income proof.

title: Ongoing catalog operations buyer request
finding: Body asks for 5–10 hours weekly across supplier feeds and several apps; advertised US$7–12/hour.
limits: Scope is broader than our offer. Metadata conflicts on weekly hours. Buyer request, not paid rate or a representative market average.

title: Small product-import buyer request
finding: One small import job advertises US$5–15/hour and 5–10 proposals.
limits: Index only. Not a paid outcome or estimate of usual market wages.

title: Multi-vendor variants and pricing buyer request
finding: Requests vendor import, variant grouping and pricing-update assistance; US$12–27/hour advertised.
limits: Request, not confirmed payment; no evidence of low maintenance.

title: Completed Matrixify work-history signal
finding: Indexed Matrixify developer contract shows a rating and Feb 23–Mar 25, 2026 dates.
limits: Earnings private and direct history not independently opened; related service signal only.

title: Bulk import job with hires
type: Buyer request with hiring signal, indexed
finding: Indexed request shows two hires for a supplier-product import project.
limits: Two hires are not evidence of completed payment, profit or successful delivery.

title: Stock Sync critical reviews
finding: Historical complaints describe setup/support difficulties; vendor responses offer assistance.
limits: Selected negative-review sample is not representative and is older than 2026; overall listing is strongly positive.

title: Shopify API versioning
finding: Regular API releases and deprecations create continuing maintenance work.
limits: No estimate of maintenance hours follows from this source.

title: Upwork automation policy
finding: Unapproved automated platform access is restricted; API access remains use-case bounded.
limits: Does not authorize prospect scraping or auto-proposals. Customer acquisition cannot be assumed fully automated.

title: Shopify inventory CSV
finding: Documents native location inventory files and current-versus-new safety validation.
limits: Native protection narrows the gap for an independent overwrite-checking product.

title: Source-backed specialist enrichment request
finding: Requests verified specifications, provenance and compatibility information, starting with a small paid sample.
limits: Direct page returned 403. Specialized domain research is labor-intensive; not proof of low-touch enrichment.

title: Broad catalog-data specialist request
finding: Seeks specification research, categorization, images, replacements and ongoing catalog improvement.
limits: Direct page returned 403. Broad service request does not validate separate products for each subtask.

title: Upwork buyer request: Shopify catalog organization and UX improvement
finding: Advertises US$25–50/hour, one hire and 50+ proposals for a broad technical catalog/UX role. The listing is restricted to U.S.-located freelancers.
limits: Not accessible to the Canadian user as advertised; broader than file preparation. Advertised budget and hire count do not establish final price, payment, margin or typical market rates.
access: Search-index extract; direct page not independently verified
